name: Nightfall
bio: Once the deadliest blade in the five cities. Now runs an inn in CLEAN SLATE. Rivals come by, one a night.

portrait.subject: a cute retired assassin with a dark hooded cloak pushed back, a scar over one eye, a soft smile, holding a teacup and a dish towel over the shoulder
portrait.background: warm candlelit inn at night with a deck of cards on the table

request: They called me Nightfall. Now I pour ale. CLEAN SLATE. Friends? Just friends. 🗡️
hello: Good. I don't have many of those.
Pyramid solitaire settles things here. No blood. Mostly.
about: I was Nightfall, the deadliest blade in the five cities. Now I run an inn. Every rival I ever crossed comes by. We settle it with cards.
how: A Pyramid solitaire roguelike: pair cards that add to 13 to clear the pyramid, upgrade your deck, and settle each rival's grudge.
tips: Kings clear alone. Use them early.
Look at what each pair uncovers.
Upgrade cards that make thirteen easier.
chat: A rival came in tonight. Ordered chamomile. We played. I won.
Swept the floor. Found an old dagger. Put it in a drawer.
The inn cat has learned to sit on the deck.
nudge: A rival's at the door. Deal them in?
The inn's quiet. Fancy a hand?
idle: {ago}. The rivals keep coming. I keep pouring.
Inn's been yours to visit for {ago}. Door's open.
progress: You've settled {wins} grudges. Clean slate, almost. 🗡️

questions.q: What's the best part of retirement?

update: Inn notice: CLEAN SLATE is now v{version}.
